# IrisFlow

IrisFlow is a free, MIT-licensed open-source project management tool for small teams. It combines the most-loved features of Trello (drag-and-drop kanban boards), Asana (My Tasks and list views), ClickUp (multiple views, priorities, automations), and Monday.com (color-coded status tables and dashboards), and self-hosts on Cloudflare's free tier for $0/month.

## Features

- Kanban board: drag-and-drop cards, custom colored columns, tags, checklists, quick-add.
- My Tasks: personal cross-project agenda grouped by Overdue, Today, This week, Later.
- Table view: inline-editable grid with status pills, priorities, assignees, due dates.
- Calendar view: monthly grid of tasks by due date.
- Dashboard: open-work donut by project, workload per person, project progress bars.
- Automations: checklist-complete → done, done → checklist checked, recurring tasks.
- Offline-first saving with sync to Cloudflare KV; JSON export/import for no lock-in.

## Pricing

Free forever. MIT license. Runs inside Cloudflare's free tier (Workers + KV); a small team never exceeds the free limits.

## Requirements

A free Cloudflare account and the wrangler CLI. One KV namespace, one passphrase secret, one `wrangler deploy`. No database server, no build step.
